prompts: A small stainless steel saucepan with a vivid orange-red sofrito of finely chopped green scallions gently sautéing in oil and ground annatto and cumin, wooden spoon resting in the saucepan. Colombian tamal tolimense preparation. No tomato, no rice, no corn dough yet.

Empty clean domestic electric oven preheating, warm interior light, middle wire rack clearly visible, oven door slightly open for photograph. No food inside, no words or numbers visible. Colombian roast pork recipe preparation.

A whole cooked golden Colombian boneless skinless pork leg roast, natural oval irregular shape about 3kg, resting completely uncut on a light wooden carving board with juice channel, loosely tented with aluminum foil lifted enough to reveal the browned meat. Small stainless roasting pan blurred in background. No crackling skin, no bone, no slices.

Roast pork pan juices simmering in a small stainless saucepan, glossy light brown sauce with tiny aromatic particles, subtle steam, ladle resting inside. Empty stainless roasting pan blurred behind, a whole pork roast loosely covered with foil blurred to side. No gravy powder, no cream, no bay leaves floating. Close-up sauce is the subject.
